name: tests-wall
cmd: set -o pipefail; grep -c 'hashOf' core/exists.ts; grep -c 'revived' core/finite-houdini.ts; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun test core/count-cubes.test.ts core/runtime-keys.test.ts core/compile.test.ts core/exists-support.test.ts core/small-laws.test.ts core/sample-cache.test.ts core/cube-rows.test.ts core/quorum-laws.test.ts core/counts-preflight.test.ts core/exists.test.ts research/track-gen/t14-stutter.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -40

name: check
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -30; st=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo CHECK_EXIT $st; exit $st

name: prof-generation
cmd: set -o pipefail; grep -c 'hashOf' core/exists.ts; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && mkdir -p prof && GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=1 timeout -s KILL 120 bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-md --cpu-prof-dir=prof --cpu-prof-interval=2000 research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts mldr > gen.out 2> gen.err; echo EXIT $?; grep -v 'T13_DATA' gen.err | grep '\[infer join small instance\|\[infer join pool\|"phases"\|finite Houdini\|finite drop' | cut -c1-400; echo PROFILE; f=$(ls prof/*.md | head -1); sed -n 1,60p "$f"

name: gen-x3
cmd: set -o pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && for r in 1 2 3; do GDP_COUNTS_TRACE=1 timeout -s KILL 120 bun research/track-gen/t13-generation.ts mldr 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -v T13_DATA | grep '"phases"\|finite Houdini' | cut -c1-300; done
